incidents.title: Disk full, with free space showing
incidents.summary: btrfs threw ENOSPC while df looked fine. 206 snapper snapshots had used up the metadata chunks. Bulk-deleted them, rebalanced, and tightened retention.

incidents.title: Containers lost DNS after reboot
incidents.summary: A race between Podman's network namespace and service start. Added a small unit that waits for the netns before anything else starts.

incidents.title: Forgejo forgot everything on restart
incidents.summary: Wrong mount path in the volume quadlet. Fixed the path and moved config into FORGEJO__section__key environment variables.

incidents.title: Everyone was a Grafana viewer
incidents.summary: SSO logins came through without roles. Added the entitlements scope in Authentik and corrected the role attribute path.
